fusions.name: Misdirected Swat
fusions.desc: Flicks a bolt that deals 7 damage, with a 35% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds. You hold 4 charges and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Pilfering Finish
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 16 damage to an enemy at or below 25% health and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each.

fusions.name: Now You Don't
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Ill-Gotten Edge
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your next strike has 30% more critical chance. Once every 6 seconds.
